sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Earth Release, Wind Release.

system.description:
You form spinning discs of dust that are launched rapidly, with additional volleys possible at your choice.

Make a ranged ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack against a creature you can see in range, dealing 2d10 slashing and 2d10 earth damage. You can spend an additional 4 chakra, to make an additional attack, but against a different creature you can see in range. You can repeat this attack up to three times. If you score a critical hit with an attack made with this jutsu, you refund the chakra cost associated with the attack.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can target the same creature with one additional attack if you make extra attacks with this jutsu’s effect. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the damage by 1d10 of each damage type. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can choose to instead choose up to 4 creatures, and make a single attack, comparing the result against each of their AC. You can spend the additional chakra to make additional attacks, targeting all previously targeting creatures up to three additional times.
